title: pimpinella verrucosa var. simensis
intro: Pimpinella verrucosa var. simensis, commonly known as Himalayan burn plant, is a plant species that belongs to the carrot family (Apiaceae). It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Pimpinella verrucosa var. simensis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
